blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval enable transfer between modalities without direct paired supervision. However, existing methods often prioritize sample-level alignment, overlooking local discriminative information and partwise statistical relations. To this end, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality. Specifically, we first present a multi-granularity covariance regularization module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality-pivot pairs, stabilizing local estimates through adaptive blending with their cross-part means. Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning module that infers global and partwise statistical relations between target modalities through regularized covariance composition and extracts paired projection directions and their correlation strengths via whitening and spectral decomposition. Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion module that standardizes and fuses matching scores from global and local relations, incorporating task-specific information on pivot associations and class semantics for class prediction and candidate ranking. Extensive experiments across ten datasets demonstrate that PRAM achieves state-of-the-art performance in 16 classification settings and 19 retrieval settings, while exhibiting highly competitive performance in three sensing scenarios.
blocks.zh: 紧急的跨模式分类和检索使不同模式之间的转移成为可能,而没有直接的对等监督。 然而,现有方法往往优先考虑抽样一级的统一,忽略当地的歧视信息,以及部分的统计关系。 为此,我们提议采用不同模式(PRAM)进行局部推理,通过共享支点模式将部分统计关系组合成冻结编码器中的潜在多式联运知识激活。 具体地说,我们首先提出一个多角共变常态模块,在两种模式-中枢对的集合中估算出来自全球和地方向量的共相性,通过适应性与它们的跨部分方式相混合来稳定当地的估计。 第二,我们设计了一个以光谱关系推理模块为支柱,该模块通过常态化共变组成推断出目标模式之间的全球和部分统计关系,并通过白化和光谱分解提取成对的投影方向及其相关优势。 最后,我们引入了一个多角度分数聚变模块,将全球和地方关系分数相匹配的分数标准化和引信化,纳入特定任务信息,介绍枢轴协会和类语义,用于班级预测和候选人排名. 跨越10个数据集的广泛实验表明,PRAM在16个分类设置和19个检索设置中实现了最先进的性能,同时在三种感知情景中表现出了高度竞争性的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Cross-modal classification and retrieval [ 55 , 30 , 79 ] connect modalities to exploit complementary information for class prediction and sample matching.
Emergent cross-modal classification [ 20 ] and retrieval [ 74 ] extend these capabilities through existing modality–pivot pairs without direct pairing between target modalities (Figure 1 (a)).
Reusing these pairs and knowledge from pretrained models helps reduce additional paired data requirements, supporting multimodal applications on robots [ 34 ] , vehicles [ 54 ] , and wearable devices [ 13 ] under data constraints.
blocks.zh:
跨模式分类和检索 [55, 30, 79] 连接模式,利用补充信息进行分类预测和样本匹配.
紧急跨模式分类[20]和检索[74]通过现有的模式-中枢对来扩展这些能力,而不在目标模式之间直接对等(图1(a))。
从预先训练过的模型中再利用这些配对和知识有助于减少额外的配对数据要求,支持机器人[34]、车辆[54]和数据限制下的可穿戴装置[13]的多式应用。

blocks.en:
Existing research [ 69 , 8 , 52 , 74 ] on emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval primarily relies on a shared pivot modality for modality alignment and pretrained representations for cross-modal relation modeling.
For example, ImageBind [ 20 ] and LanguageBind [ 85 ] use image and language as their respective shared pivot modalities, learning modality alignment from modality–pivot pairs and demonstrating emergent retrieval between target modalities without direct paired supervision.
Building on these pretrained representations, related methods [ 48 , 82 , 22 ] compute matching scores between target modalities through global vector matching [ 53 ] , association through shared anchors [ 50 ] , or modality mapping [ 27 ] , as illustrated in Figure 1 (b).
MaskCLIP [ 84 ] further shows that frozen CLIP features support local semantic prediction beyond standard image-level outputs, providing evidence for exploiting local semantic information in pretrained encoders.
We refer to information that is already present in frozen encoders yet remains incompletely expressed in their standard outputs as latent multimodal knowledge.
However, sample-level cross-modal relation modeling often neglects to preserve local discriminative information and compose partwise statistical relations, limiting the use of latent multimodal knowledge for classification and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
现有关于新兴跨模式分类和检索的研究[69、8、52、74]主要依靠一种共同的关键模式,用于模式的调整和跨模式关系模型的预选表述。
例如,ImageBind [20]和LanguageBind [85] 使用图像和语言作为各自共享的中枢模式,从模式-中枢对齐学习模式并显示在目标模式之间出现的检索,而无需直接对齐监管.
根据这些预先经过培训的表述,相关方法[48、82、22]通过全球矢量匹配[53]、通过共享锚地关联[50]或模式映射[27]计算目标模式之间的对应分数,如图1(b)所示。
MaskCLIP [84] 进一步显示被冻结的CLIP特征支持了超出标准图像级输出的本地语义预测,为在被预先训练的编码器中利用本地语义信息提供证据.
我们提到冻结编码器中已经存在的信息,但是在其标准产出中仍未完全表述为潜在的多模式知识。
然而,样本一级的跨模式关系模式往往忽略了保存当地歧视性信息并构成部分统计关系,限制了潜在多模式知识用于分类和检索。

blocks.en:
Just as a friend of a friend is not necessarily a friend, knowing that entities are connected does not mean knowing how they are related.
For emergent cross-modal tasks, statistical relations for both modality–pivot pairs do not guarantee full recovery of partwise statistical relations between target modalities.
Relation recovery depends on preserving local discriminative information in the pivot representation and maintaining correspondence between partwise statistical relations on both sides.
Therefore, representation granularity and pivot capacity limit which partwise statistical relations can be recovered and how effectively latent multimodal knowledge supports classification and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
正如朋友的朋友不一定是朋友一样,知道实体是相互联系的并不意味着知道它们是如何联系在一起的。
对于新兴的跨模式任务,两种模式-中枢对的统计关系并不能保证完全恢复目标模式之间的部分统计关系。
恢复关系取决于在关键表述中保留当地歧视信息,并保持双方部分统计关系之间的对应关系。
因此,可部分恢复哪些统计关系,以及潜在的多模式知识如何有效支持分类和检索,其代表性颗粒性和支柱能力受到限制。

blocks.en:
For that, we propose partwise reasoning across modalities (PRAM), which activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality to support classification and retrieval, from Figure 1 (c).
First, we present a multi-granularity covariance regularization (MCR) module that estimates covariances from global and local vectors in two collections of modality–pivot pairs and adaptively blends local estimates with cross-part means per modality pair, improving stability with limited samples.
Second, we devise a pivot-based spectral relational reasoning (PSRR) module inferring global and partwise statistical relations between modalities via regularized covariance composition globally and at corresponding pivot parts, extracting paired projection directions and correlation strengths through whitening and spectral decomposition.
Finally, we introduce a multi-granularity score fusion (MSF) module that standardizes and fuses global and local matching scores derived from projection responses and correlation strengths.
For classification, these scores are augmented with pivot associations and class semantics as applicable; for retrieval, they rank candidates.
Throughout this process, encoders remain frozen, and relation estimation and score standardization use only modality–pivot pairs, without any direct pairs between target modalities.
Experiments across ten datasets using ImageBind and LanguageBind, together with evaluations in robot localization, cross-device vehicle localization, and wearable action recognition, demonstrate PRAM’s effectiveness and competitive performance.
The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose PRAM for emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval between unpaired modalities, activating frozen encoders’ latent multimodal knowledge by composing partwise statistical relations via a shared pivot. • We devise MCR, PSRR, and MSF to stabilize covariance estimates, infer partwise statistical relations, and fuse global and local matching scores, using only modality–pivot pairs to estimate relations and standardize scores. • Across ImageBind and LanguageBind, PRAM achieves the best results in 16 of 17 classification and 19 of 20 retrieval settings across ten datasets, while demonstrating its effectiveness in three sensing scenarios.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提议在模式(PRAM)之间进行部分推理,通过共享支点模式,从图1(c)中形成部分统计关系,激活冻结编码器中潜在的多模式知识,以支持分类和检索。
首先,我们提出一个多角共变常态模块(MCR),该模块在模式-中枢对两个集合中估算出全球和本地向量的共变,并因地制宜地将本地估计值与每个模式对对的跨段手段相混合,用有限的样本来提高稳定性。
其次,我们设计了一个以分位点为基础的光谱关系推理模块(PSRR),通过全球常态化共变组成和相应的分位点,推断各种模式之间的全球和部分统计关系,通过白化和光谱分解提取成对的投影方向和相通优势。
最后,我们采用了一个多角分数聚变模块,通过预测反应和相关性优势,将全球和本地对等分数标准化并引信。
就分类而言,这些分数可酌情由枢轴协会和班级语义学加以增加;对于检索,则按考生排名。
在整个过程中,编码器仍然被冻结,关系估计和分数标准化只使用模式-中枢对,目标模式之间没有任何直接对.
利用ImageBind和LanguageBind进行十套数据集的实验,以及机器人本地化、跨设备车辆本地化和可穿戴动作识别等方面的评价,都显示了PRAM的有效性和竞争性性能.
主要贡献概述如下: 我们建议在未开发模式之间进行新兴的跨模式分类和检索,通过共享枢轴组成部分统计关系,激活被冻结编码者潜在的多模式知识。 我们设计了MCR、PSRR和MSF来稳定共变估计,部分地推断统计关系,并且将全球和本地的匹配分数融为一体,只使用模式对对来估计关系并标准化分数。 • 在整个ImageBind和LanguageBind,PRAM在17个分类中的16个和跨越10个数据集的20个检索设置中的19个取得了最佳结果,同时在三种感知情景中显示出其有效性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multimodal Alignment. Contrastive image–text pretraining [ 55 ] and locked-encoder alignment [ 78 ] establish shared multimodal representations, while ImageBind [ 20 ] and LanguageBind [ 85 ] extend modality alignment through image and language pivots.
FreeBind [ 68 ] and OmniBind [ 69 ] integrate pretrained spaces; UniBind [ 46 ] introduces modality-agnostic alignment centers, and Point-Bind [ 23 ] connects point clouds to the shared space.
Other approaches connect pretrained spaces through shared anchors [ 50 ] , semantic correspondences [ 48 ] , overlapping modalities [ 82 ] , text descriptions [ 27 ] , relational geometry [ 1 ] , or sample neighborhoods [ 22 ] ; CSA [ 42 ] aligns unimodal features via canonical correlations from limited pairs.
Representation-similarity analyses [ 29 ] characterize geometric agreement between independently learned spaces.
Further strategies synthesize bridge embeddings [ 74 ] , infer connections through intermediate variables [ 8 ] , learn modality pairs sequentially [ 45 ] , or construct pseudo-pairs through shared modalities [ 52 ] ; Bridge CorrNet [ 57 ] correlates unpaired views via a shared pivot.
However, formulations that rely on sample-level representations can obscure spatial or temporal distinctions, limiting the use of local discriminative information in emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
多式联运对齐。 相矛盾的图像-文本预训 [55] 和锁定-编码器对齐 [78] 建立了共享的多模式表示,而ImageBind [20] 和LanguageBind [85] 通过图像和语言比对扩展模式对齐.
FreeBind [68]和OmniBind [69] 融合了被预先训练的空间;UniBind [46]引入了模式-不可知的对接中心,而Point-Bind [23]将点云连接到共享空间.
其他方法通过共享锚地[50],语义对应[48],重叠模式[82],文字描述[27],关系几何[1],或样本邻接[22]来连接预受训练的空间;CSA[42]通过受限对接的单式相通关系来将单式相接.
代表性-同质性分析[29]是独立学习空间之间几何一致的特点。
进一步的战略综合了桥嵌入[74],通过中间变量推断连接[8],相继学习模式对[45],或通过共享模式构建假pairs[52]; Bridge CorrNet[57]通过共享中枢连接了未放出的观点.
然而,依赖样本一级的表述的表达方式可能会模糊空间或时间上的区别,限制在新兴的跨模式分类和检索中使用当地的歧视信息。

blocks.en:
Local Relation Modeling. Vision Transformers [ 17 ] and self-supervised encoders [ 51 ] provide spatial features, while dense correspondence learning [ 65 ] , region alignment [ 83 ] , and semantic grouping [ 75 ] support local representation learning.
Image-level supervision also supports dense prediction [ 84 ] and patch–language alignment [ 31 ] .
Local cross-modal interactions [ 24 ] and token-level late interaction [ 35 ] enable fine-grained matching.
For statistical relation estimation, canonical correlation analysis [ 28 ] and its probabilistic [ 4 ] and deep [ 3 ] variants identify shared coordinates, while partial least squares [ 71 ] emphasizes cross-covariance.
Covariance shrinkage [ 37 ] and ridge regularization [ 26 ] stabilize estimation and inversion, respectively.
Hubness [ 56 ] motivates local scaling [ 14 ] and dual-bank normalization [ 53 ] , and embedding standardization [ 2 ] reduces the CLIP modality gap.
However, these methods do not directly address how to stably compose partwise statistical relations from separate collections of modality–pivot pairs and fuse global and local matching scores with frozen encoders for classification and retrieval.
blocks.zh:
地方关系建模. Vision Transformers [17]和自控编码器[51]提供空间特征,而密集的函授学习[65],区域对接[83],语义分组[75]则支持本地代表学习.
图像级监督也支持密集预测[84]和补丁-语言对齐[31].
本地跨模式交互[24]和符号级后期交互[35]可以进行细纹相配.
对于统计关系估计,犬科关联分析[28]及其概率[4]和深[3]变体识别出共享坐标,而部分最小平方[71]则强调交叉相变.
相变收缩[37]和脊正化[26]分别稳定估计和倒置.
Hubness [56] 推动地方规模化[14]和双银行正常化[53],并嵌入标准化[2]缩小CLIP模式差距.
然而,这些方法并没有直接涉及如何从模式-中枢对的单独收集中,稳定地形成部分统计关系,并将全球和本地匹配分数与被冻结的编码器进行分类和检索。

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate 17 classification and 20 retrieval settings across ten datasets: BatVision [ 6 ] (BV), UTD-MHAD [ 11 ] (UTD), TartanRGBT [ 47 ] (TR), VGGSound [ 12 ] (VGG), NYUv2 [ 60 ] (NYU), UCF101 [ 61 ] (UCF), MSR-VTT [ 76 ] (MSR), Ego4D [ 21 ] (E4D), CART [ 40 ] (CT), and MAVD [ 62 ] (MAV).
We further evaluate PRAM in three sensing scenarios on MS2 [ 59 ] , OBV [ 41 ] , ViViD++ [ 38 ] , UTD, and CZU-MHAD [ 7 ] (CZU).
Au, D, Th, Tx, Im, V, and I denote audio, depth, thermal, text, RGB image, video, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) signals, respectively.
In the pivot-based setting, fitting, validation, registration, and score standardization use only modality–pivot training pairs.
NYU Tx–D uses class names for classification and per-image text for retrieval.

Parameters. Frozen ImageBind [ 20 ] (IB) and LanguageBind [ 85 ] (LB) provide their official sample-level embeddings as global vectors.

blocks.en:
Classification. Among pivot-only methods in Table 1 , PRAM leads 16 of 17 settings, one of them tied, and ranks second in the other.
Its mean accuracy exceeds the best baseline average by 9.7 points on IB and 2.0 on LB.
MMBind [ 52 ] is the strongest IB baseline; PRAM leads it in every IB setting, including UTD D–I (50.7 vs. 17.0).
In the two UTD cases in Figure 3 (a), 5 and 6 of PRAM’s ten label-transfer neighbors vote for jog and bowling, respectively, compared with 0 and 2 for MMBind.
The UTD cases illustrate how local relations support label transfer.

Retrieval. Among pivot-only methods in Table 2 , PRAM leads 19 of 20 settings and ranks second in the other.
Its mean R@10 exceeds the best baseline average by 11.3 points on IB and 10.4 on LB.

In Figure 3 (b), MMBind ranks five thermal frames of similar street scenes above the true match of a TR depth query, whereas PRAM ranks it first.
Figure 4 (a) shows PRAM aligning paired states and separating frames, unlike sample-level methods; Figure 4 (b) shows a distinct PRAM diagonal: true matches rank highest in 35 of 40 rows versus 6 for MMBind.
On trajectories unseen in fitting, PRAM reaches 62.7 R@10 on IB TR, compared with 10.5 for MMBind.
This helps distinguish similar scenes and generalize to unseen trajectories.

blocks.en:
Sensing Scenarios. Figure 5 uses task-specific frozen encoders and protocols beyond main-table settings. Robot localization uses AnyThermal [ 47 ] and DINOv2-B [ 51 ] features for thermal-to-depth retrieval via RGB pivots, with pose-distance success thresholds.
With MINIMA [ 58 ] , Depth Anything V2 (DAv2) [ 77 ] with AnyLoc [ 34 ] , LIP-Loc [ 54 ] , and ThermalGen [ 73 ] as baselines, PRAM reaches 55.3% within 5 m on MS2 and 31.9% within 0.25 m on OBV, versus MINIMA’s 33.4% and 23.1%, respectively.
For cross-device vehicle localization, PRAM fits relations on daytime ViViD++ RGB–thermal pairs and MS2 depth–RGB pairs across vehicles and sensors, localizing nighttime ViViD++ thermal queries against MS2 depth with 26.2% success within 5 m versus ThermalGen’s 9.6%.
Following C3T [ 33 ] , wearable action labels link to IMU via labeled videos (pivot) and unlabeled video–IMU pairs; testing uses IMU alone.
For wearables, we compare to IMU-Video-OOD-HAR (IMU-Video-OOD) [ 13 ] and reimplement C3T and its contrastive-alignment (CA) and student–teacher (ST) baselines on PRAM’s splits.
PRAM’s IMU-only top-1, averaged over seeds 1–3, reaches 80.6% on UTD versus C3T’s 52.7%, and 90.8% on CZU versus CA’s 85.9%.
Activated relations support cross-sensor localization and IMU-only recognition.

以MINIMA [58] 为基线,以AnyLoc [34]、LIP-Loc [54] 为深度Anything V2(Dav2) [77] 为基线,PRAM在MS2的5米以内为55.3%,在OBV的0.25米以内为31.9%,而MINIMA的33.4%和23.1%分别为55.3%。
对于跨设备车辆本地化,PRAM符合日间维维D++的关系 RGB — 热成对和MS2深度 — RGB对接车辆和传感器, 本地化了夜间ViViD++对MS2深度的热问, 成功率在 5 m 以26.2%对热源9.6%.
继C3T [33]后,可穿戴的动作标签通过有标签的视频(中枢)和无标签的视频-IMU对连接到IMU;测试单独使用IMU.
关于可穿戴性,我们比较IMU-Video-OOD-HAR(IMU-Video-OOOD)[13] 和重新执行C3T及其对比-对等(CA)和学生-教师(ST)基线(PRAM)的分法。
PRAM的IMU-唯一前1名,平均在种子1-3上达到80.6%的UTD比C3T的52.7%,在CZU比CA的85.9%达到90.8%.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present PRAM for emergent cross-modal classification and retrieval without direct paired supervision between target modalities.
Using only modality–pivot pairs, PRAM activates latent multimodal knowledge in frozen encoders by preserving local discriminative information and composing partwise statistical relations through a shared pivot modality.
MCR stabilizes covariance estimates, PSRR recovers global and partwise statistical relations, and MSF combines standardized matching scores with task-specific pivot associations and class semantics for classification and candidate ranking.
Experiments on ImageBind and LanguageBind across ten datasets show that PRAM achieves the best results in 16 of 17 classification and 19 of 20 retrieval settings, with mean bidirectional R@10 reaching 32.9% and 53.4%, respectively.
Evaluations in three sensing scenarios demonstrate its effectiveness across visual and inertial encoders.
blocks.zh:
我们提出应急跨模式分类和检索的PRAM,而不对目标模式进行直接对等监督。
PRAM只使用模式-中枢对,通过保存局部歧义信息并通过共享中枢模式将部分统计关系构成,激活了被冻结编码器中的潜在多模式知识.
MCR稳定了共分性估计,PSRR恢复了全球和部分的统计关系,MSF将标准化的比对分与任务特定枢轴协会和类语义结合,用于分类和候选人排名.
对10个数据集的ImageBind和LanguageBind的实验显示,PRAM在17个分类中的16个和20个检索设置中的19个取得了最佳结果,平均双向R@10分别达到32.9%和53.4%.
在三种感知情景中进行的评价表明,它在视觉和惯性编码器中具有效力。

blocks.en:
This subsection defines each ablation in Table 3 of the main text.
Global-only PRAM fits the complete framework on the official global vectors; “No Global” removes the separate global component from all score routes, using local parts for correlation composition and covariance mapping and the local-mean predictor for state and class-semantic routes while retaining broadcast descriptors for single-vector modalities.
“No Shrinkage” sets the cross-part shrinkage intensity α = 0 \alpha=0 , so each part keeps its own sample covariance.
Partwise ASIF applies the ASIF adaptation of Sec. 10.7 to the local vectors and selects among its six configurations on held-out modality–pivot pairs.
“No Quadratic” removes the endpoint-magnitude terms from ℓ g \ell_{g} .
“No Covariance” and “No Pivot Associations” set w = 0 w=0 and o = 0 o=0 , removing the covariance and pivot-association scores; “No Standardization” removes the reference-bank transformation.
“No Class Semantics” removes the class-semantic route by setting τ A = 0 \tau_{A}=0 .
All remaining feature, split, and decision conventions are fixed.
Pivot-association and class-semantic scores contribute only to classification decisions, so these removals leave retrieval by R R unchanged.
Removing an inactive component also retains the full-model result.

blocks.en:
The localization comparison covers seven method families: MINIMA [ 58 ] , Depth Anything V2 (DAv2) [ 77 ] with AnyLoc [ 34 ] , LIP-Loc [ 54 ] , ThermalGen [ 73 ] , DINOv2-G [ 51 ] with AnyLoc, Omnivorous-DINO [ 32 ] , and LC 2 [ 39 ] .

The Omnivorous comparison combines AnyThermal with the released Omnivorous-DINO encoder.

blocks.en: 15.4 Wearable Action Recognition
blocks.zh: 15.4 可穿戴的行动确认

blocks.en:
The C3T [ 33 ] protocol provides labeled video and unlabeled paired video–IMU samples, with only IMU supplied at test time.
PRAM connects category-indicator vectors to IMU through the video pivot.
The video representation is chosen from ImageBind frames and the ResNet18 representation used by C3T.
The IMU candidates are ImageBind, PRIMUS [ 16 ] , and the AnyMo graph encoder [ 9 ] , selected using the paired training edges without IMU labels.
UTD-MHAD selects ImageBind video with AnyMo IMU; CZU-MHAD [ 7 ] selects ResNet18 video with ImageBind IMU.
ASIF and MMBind use the same video and IMU features as PRAM on each dataset.
ASIF selects its configuration for each seed by R@10 on held-out pivot pairs, without test data or labeled validation data.
For these PRAM features, the AnyMo latent sequence is averaged into eight time bins.
Every UTD clip uses the right-hand sensor node, independently of its action label.
CZU depth-video preprocessing uses the dataset’s foreground crop for all video-based comparators; its ten inertial sensors are concatenated with side identities preserved.
Table S26 reports top-1 and top-3 means over seeds 1–3.
Table S28 adds the standard deviations over seeds; PRAM has the highest top-1 accuracy in each of the three seeds on both datasets.
For each of seeds 1–3, the 861 UTD-MHAD clips are split with class stratification, pooling the eight subjects, into 86 IMU-only test clips, 86 IMU-only validation clips, 344 labeled videos, and 345 unlabeled video–IMU pairs, following the 10/10/40/40 fractions of C3T [ 33 ] .
On these splits, PRAM with ImageBind instead of AnyMo IMU features reaches 79.5 ± \,\pm\, 1.8% top-1, versus C3T’s reported 62.5% on its own splits.

blocks.en: 16 Limitations
blocks.zh: 16 限制

blocks.en:
PRAM uses registered spatial cells or synchronized time segments as parts; a single global vector is broadcast across the other modality’s parts.
Relations use covariances of features from frozen encoders.
Extensions include learned or adaptive correspondence for unregistered inputs and integration with fine-tuned encoders.
blocks.zh:
PRAM使用已注册的空间细胞或同步的时间段作为部件;一个单一的全球矢量通过其他模式的部件进行广播.
关系使用从被冻结的编码器中调取的特征的共性.
扩展内容包括用于未注册输入的已学习或适应性通信,以及与微调编码器的整合.
